column1: # The World Ends with You -Final Remix- on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Unity 2017.2 IL2CPP on SDK 4.4.1, base game 1.0.0; 458 shaders, all translated. The game is 60 fps on the Switch, and is here.
# Tested 2026-11-06 on the Legion Y700 (TB322FC, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16): the title, the tips, a new game's opening movie (H.264 + AAC, sound and
# picture), the story scenes, Scramble Crossing (walking by touch, the scan with the player pin), the first battle (running from the frogs by dragging Neku).
# 60 fps throughout: frame work p95 about 18 ms of a 16.7 ms period at the vsync, GPU about 2 ms, 0 dropped frames in each 300-frame window; no red log line; 0 audio underruns.
# Handheld, played by touch: docked the game wants one Joy-Con as a gyro pointer ("Point the Joy-Con at the center of the screen"), so the pause menu starts in handheld
# mode with the on-screen gamepad hidden. A drag that starts at the tablet's left edge is Android's back gesture (the pause menu).
# The opening movie crashed the game 1 run in 2 at its end, until a second end-of-stream packet gave no decoder output (hle_movie.c h_movie_SendIn); 3 of 3 runs after.
# Not tested yet: a save point, the later battles (psych pins), the staff roll movie
